scope: The eight actual associated constants, eleven public conversions and five checked 256-bit add/subtract/negation methods with exact integer values and exact Overflow partitions; U256::div_rem and U256::checked_div with exact canonical quotient, rounding and refusal contracts; U256::full_product and U256::checked_mul with exact product contracts; and the U512::checked_add, U512::multiply_u256, U512::div_rem and U768::div_rem wrappers with exact sum, product and canonical quotient contracts, all without public input preconditions. The actual negative_bits dependency, the add/subtract carry and borrow helpers, the private divider, word insertion and schoolbook multiplier are refined at every limb width (the multiplier whenever its output has room for the product). U256 has no checked_neg method. The mul_div, root and signed multiply/divide families, the raw wide word views, other arithmetic and compiler/ghost-erasure correspondence are not proved.
assumptions: Soundness of the pinned Verus frontend, vstd specifications and SMT solver.
Correspondence between Rust compilation and the proof frontend, including ghost erasure and the reviewed constant annotations.
Standard Rust fixed-width integer and array semantics as specified by the pinned verifier; native execution is separately tested.

obligations.meaning: Exact zero extension: unsigned(result) = input.
Exact value iff input < 2^128; otherwise exactly Overflow.
Exact sign extension: signed(result) = input.
Exact absolute signed value, including -2^255.
Apply the requested sign, accepting zero with either sign; exact value iff in [-2^255,2^255), else Overflow.
Exact unsigned value iff signed input is nonnegative; otherwise exactly Overflow.
Exact unsigned(a)-unsigned(b) iff the difference fits [-2^255,2^255), else Overflow; no early narrowing.
Exact zero extension into 512 bits.
Exact value iff every high limb is zero, equivalently input < 2^256; otherwise exactly Overflow.
Exact zero extension into 768 bits.
Exact value iff every high limb is zero, equivalently input < 2^256; otherwise exactly Overflow.
Exact unsigned sum iff it is below 2^256; otherwise exactly Overflow.
Exact unsigned difference iff nonnegative; otherwise exactly Overflow. Same statement as the conversion dependency.
Exact signed sum iff in [-2^255,2^255); otherwise exactly Overflow.
Exact signed difference iff in [-2^255,2^255); otherwise exactly Overflow.
Exact signed negation except at -2^255, which returns exactly Overflow; zero maps to zero.
For D > 0, exactly the canonical witness N = Q*D + R with Q >= 0 and 0 <= R < D; for D = 0, exactly ZeroDivisor.
ZeroDivisor iff D = 0; otherwise Inexact iff Exact and N mod D > 0; otherwise floor(N/D), or ceil(N/D) for Ceil, with the exact Overflow partition of that value.
Always succeeds with the exact 512-bit product: W(result) = U(a)*U(b).
Exact product iff it is below 2^256; otherwise exactly Overflow.
Exact 512-bit sum iff it is below 2^512; otherwise exactly Overflow.
Always succeeds with the exact 768-bit product: W768(result) = W(a)*U(b).
For D > 0, exactly the canonical 512-bit witness N = Q*D + R with 0 <= R < D; for D = 0, exactly ZeroDivisor.
For D > 0, exactly the canonical 768-bit witness N = Q*D + R with 0 <= R < D; for D = 0, exactly ZeroDivisor.
